title: client.config
description: Per-client, NON-SECRET config for one salon-booking-bot deployment.

googleCalendarId.description: Calendar the bot books into (freeBusy + events); a calendar shared with the service account. Real value in n8n Load Config; placeholder here.

channels.description: Config-gated channels; a channel omitted here is OFF. Several may be enabled at once — the brain is channel-agnostic: every inbound message is normalized to {channel, sender_key, text} with sender_key = '{channel}:{id}', and the reply always returns to the origin channel. instagram ships default OFF: live connection is per-client (Meta app review, business account, 24h messaging window).

workingHours.description: Per weekday (mon..sun): array of HH:MM-HH:MM ranges; [] means closed.

sessionGapMinutes.description: Idle minutes after which a returning sender's next message is treated as a new session → 'Welcome back' greeting (CP6).

killSwitch.description: Emergency stop — when true the bot is handoff-only (no LLM, no writes).

messageTemplates.description: Named reply templates; may contain {service},{date},{time} placeholders.

faq.description: Free-text answers for FAQ topics NOT derivable from structured config (price/hours/services are computed from services[]/workingHours). A topic without an entry here → deterministic deflect via messageTemplates.faqUnknown (never an LLM guess).

provider.description: Adapter id — e.g. whatsapp: zernio · widget: webchat · instagram: meta-graph
